summary_paragraph: Mr. Thompson was admitted for his second cycle of high-dose methotrexate reinduction therapy for recurrent primary central nervous system lymphoma. A port-a-cath was successfully placed on admission to facilitate chemotherapy delivery. He experienced mild, transient hypokalemia managed with IV supplementation and mild nausea controlled with antiemetics. His transaminases peaked as expected and began to decline. He reported gradual improvement in gait stability, though dizziness persisted. Methotrexate levels cleared appropriately, allowing for safe discharge. He is scheduled to receive outpatient rituximab and return in two weeks for his next cycle, with ongoing monitoring of neurological symptoms and treatment response.
problems: Primary central nervous system lymphoma, unspecified site, extranodal and solid organ sites
